Sociology Optional 2026 | UPSC Mains 2026 | Sociology Optional New Pattern & Strategy

Are you preparing for UPSC Civil Services Mains 2026 with Sociology Optional? In this video, we discuss the changing approach towards Sociology Optional, important observations from the UPSC Mains 2026 Sociology paper, and how aspirants should adapt their preparation and answer-writing strategy.
If you are targeting UPSC CSE 2026 and have opted for Sociology as your optional subject, this session will help you understand how to approach questions more effectively. We discuss the Sociology Optional pattern, question approach, answer writing, conceptual clarity, thinkers, examples, and preparation strategy.

The session also focuses on what candidates should keep in mind while preparing for Sociology Optional Paper 1 and Paper 2, especially when the questions demand application, analytical thinking and relevant examples.

If you're preparing for UPSC CSE, IAS, Civil Services Examination or Sociology Optional, watch this video till the end and understand the approach required for effective preparation.
